purpose: Records the exact reproducibility environment identity for the eight external-oracle certification runners. VALIDATION_STANDARD.md s2 rule 4 requires pinned dependencies and checksummed data assets; PyJHora declares no dependencies, so the repository must record the closure itself.

runtime.abi_constraint: Lock hashes are CPython 3.11 linux x86_64 wheels. Another Python minor version or platform requires its own lock and its own recorded identity; it MUST NOT be obtained by relaxing hashes.

oracle.discovery_method: Iterative import-failure resolution inside an isolated venv with no system site-packages, 2026-08-10. Each missing module was installed and the runner re-invoked until it completed.
oracle.authority_note: PyJHora is a comparison oracle, never astronomical ground truth. Root D-001 fixes the numerical authority as swetest 2.10.03; root D-007 governs how oracle divergence is handled.

swiss_ephemeris.reference_binary_provenance: Built from https://github.com/aloistr/swisseph tag v2.10.03 per BUILD_INFO.txt
swiss_ephemeris.ephemeris_mode: strict SWIEPH; silent Moshier fallback raises

certify_d7.py.function: saptamsa_chart method 1 Traditional Parasara (pure longitude math)

certify_d12.py.function: dwadasamsa_chart method 1 Traditional Parasara (pure longitude math)

certify_d30.py.function: trimsamsa_chart method 1 Traditional Parasara (pure longitude math)

certify_parashari_drishti.py.function: graha_drishti_from_chart (pure combinatorics on our certified placements)

certify_vimshottari.py.detail: The oracle's own Moon longitude is injected into this engine's timeline so the comparison isolates timeline mathematics from oracle astronomy. The engine Moon remains swetest-certified per D-001. Per-case Moon deltas are recorded in the artifact.

certify_transits.py.detail: Oracle Sun differs from the certified Sun by ~20.5 arcsec at compared instants; the magnitude is consistent with aberration-handling differences and the CAUSE IS NOT VERIFIED. Oracle ingress search carries ~1 min slop. Tolerances are derived per event from measured deltas and are never assumed or widened to absorb the divergence.

hermetic_tier_note: The default pytest gate, all eleven independent holdout validators, and the three non-oracle certifiers (certify_current_engine, certify_kp_chain, certify_sign_convention) import no oracle and require no network. Verified by grep: no file under engine/tests/ and no validate_*.py imports jhora.

verification_2026_08_10.method: Fresh venv with no system site-packages; install from requirements-oracle.lock alone with --require-hashes; run all eight oracle certifiers.
verification_2026_08_10.artifact_content_delta: Only the 'date' field changed (run date). All gate values byte-identical.
